title: bribes.fyi exposes corruption in India via public bribe #bribesfyi #anticorruption #aitechnology
description: A developer in Bangalore launched bribes.fyi, a website that allows anyone in India to report bribes paid to government departments. The platform reveals real-time data on corruption by department, state, and amount, highlighting regions like Karnataka and Maharashtra with the highest bribe reports. Bribes.fyi showcases how AI enables non-technical individuals to create impactful tools that promote transparency and accountability. The site empowers citizens to contribute valuable data, transforming individual experiences into a collective resource against corruption. By exposing patterns of bribery, bribes.fyi offers insights for policymakers, activists, and citizens seeking to address systemic corruption in India. This project exemplifies the growing role of AI-driven grassroots innovation in fostering social change. #bribesfyi #corruptionindia #AIforGood #anticorruption #BangaloreDeveloper #indiatech #govtransparency #civictech #bribereporting #AIinnovation #socialimpact #techforgood #datadriven #indianews #IndiaCorruption
